Title: Valid login reaches inbox
Steps: Open login > enter email+password > Sign in

Title: Wrong password rejected
Steps: Open login > valid email + wrong password > Sign in
Expected result: Error shown; no session; still on login form

Title: Logout then Back does not expose mailbox
Expected result: Login form shown; no mailbox content

Title: Empty username/password validation
Implemented / note: No - browser/native validation, same code path as AUTH-02

Title: Repeated failed logins / CAPTCHA / rate limit
Expected result: Rate limit or human verification appears
Implemented / note: No - behaviour changes, can lock test accounts

Title: Session expiry and concurrent sessions
Steps: Log in on A and B > sign out on A > act on B
Implemented / note: No - needs long waits / state control

Title: Send and receive (two-account when configured, else self-loop)
Steps: Sender composes to receiver > Send > receiver waits for inbox > open
Expected result: Subject, body, sender correct on receiver side; copy in Sent

Title: Send without recipient blocked
Expected result: Composer stays open; no Sent copy

Title: To + CC both receive
Implemented / note: Yes - compose.cy.js - needs 2nd account, skipped otherwise

Title: BCC recipients hidden from others
Steps: To=A, BCC=B > Send > inspect A's headers
Implemented / note: No - needs third mailbox; header inspection

Title: Rich text, signature, large body
Steps: Format text, add signature, paste 100KB body

Title: Auto-save survives reload
Steps: Fill composer > close > reload > Drafts > reopen

Title: Draft to sent transition
Steps: Save draft > reopen > add recipient > Send
Expected result: Draft leaves Drafts; appears in Sent; receiver gets it

Title: Mark unread then open marks read
Steps: Mark unread > verify > open > back to inbox

Title: Archive message
Implemented / note: Backlog - archive covered indirectly by FILTER-01

Title: Keyword + sender (multi-condition)
Preconditions: Two messages sharing token, different senders
Implemented / note: Yes - search.cy.js - needs 2nd account, skipped otherwise

Title: Date range filter
Implemented / note: No - cannot back-date mail; needs seeded old data

Title: Create filter; match vs non-match
Preconditions: Sender logged in; free tier allows 1 filter
Steps: Create filter "subject contains token > archive" > self-send matching and non-matching mail
Expected result: Matching mail in Archive and absent from Inbox; non-matching stays in Inbox; filter deleted in teardown

Title: Undo send then real send
Steps: Send > click Undo > verify composer restored, nothing in Sent > resend > wait for undo to lapse > verify delivery

Title: Delivery at scheduled time
Implemented / note: No - server-side clock; Playwright clock mocking cannot advance it

Title: Send attachment and verify bytes
Expected result: Filename shown; downloaded bytes equal source

Title: Move to custom folder
Preconditions: Seeded message; free tier folder cap
Steps: Create folder > move message > open folder
Expected result: Leaves Inbox; in folder; folder deleted in teardown

Title: HTML/script sanitisation in received mail
Steps: Send HTML with script/img beacon > open
Expected result: No script runs; remote content blocked
Implemented / note: No - needs crafted mail and judgement
